changes: primes(): 新規vectorにlimit>=16で容量予約。GCCとClang AVX2では従来の16384以上の経路を残し、16..16383を非展開のprivate helperへ移す。
Clang非AVX2ではprimes()の直接予約経路を使う。append_toの本文は不変、Clangだけ展開属性を追加。

accepted.complexity: 追加処理O(limit)。構築O(limit log log limit)、全flagsを保持しis_prime O(1)。

accepted.inlining_hints: GCC/Clangでは小素数マスクをnoinline。append_toのalways_inlineはClangだけ。GCC/Clang AVX2では小さいprimes()の容量予約をnoinlineのprivate helperに分離。Clang非AVX2は直接予約。その他は属性を除いた標準C++処理。ISAやCPU判定は追加しない。

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;out=p/'final_main_selected';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);rows=[]
for mode,flags in [('gcc_plain',[]),('gcc_lc',['-DEVAL','-DONLINE_JUDGE','-march=native'])]:
 binary=out/(mode+'_final');cmd=['taskset','-c','8','g++','-O2',*flags,'-std=c++23','-DHEADER="'+str(p/'final.hpp')+'"',str(p/'hybrid_main/main.cpp'),'-o',str(binary)];a=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True);ref=p/'hybrid_main'/(mode+'_split');left=binary.read_bytes();right=ref.read_bytes();row=dict(mode=mode,command=cmd,final_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256((p/'final.hpp').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),reference_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256((p/'hybrid_split.hpp').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(left).hexdigest(),reference_sha256=hashlib.sha256(right).hexdigest(),identical=left==right,warnings=a.stderr);rows.append(row);assert row['identical'],row

enum.decision: Reject all three enumeration approaches; retain baseline enumeration.

rejected.enum_report:
# Additional prime enumeration probes after submission 412324

No production edits. Frozen baseline SHA-256: `0ce794d7b0b38350d894f06c179fa4fe72ec344c8a21e9df8c8c73296ad78e96`.

## Candidates and decision

1. `indexed.hpp`: count, resize, then write directly into the result. Reject: zero initialization costs outweigh avoiding the capacity branch; enumeration at 1e8 / 5e8 generally becomes 8–14% slower.
2. `simd_lut.hpp`: AVX2 expands a byte mask through a constexpr position table to eight uint64 outputs. Reject: overlapping full-vector stores write substantially more bytes than needed and enumeration at 1e6+ becomes 50–85% slower. An indexed standard fallback and SIMD-disable guard were included in the prototype.
3. `from_range.hpp`: C++23 sized input range provides exact vector allocation without zero initialization. The iterator satisfies the actual input iterator requirements, and input_iterator / input_range / sized_range concepts are checked. The library feature macro gates the helper and path; fallback uses the original reserve + append implementation. This first version helped large limits but slowed the 16384 boundary.
4. `from_range_outline.hpp`: the same third candidate, restricted to limit >= 1048576 and with one out-of-line collector. Below that threshold the original count + reserve + append operations remain. Reject: gains do not satisfy the no-regression requirement across compiler and size conditions. No fourth independent algorithm was attempted.

The first two candidates were agreed initially; the parent explicitly requested the third C++23 approach after those were rejected. The fourth entry is a bounded tuning of that third approach, as authorized by the parent.

## Method

GCC 15.3 and Clang 21.1.8 with libstdc++ 15.3; C++23, O2, EVAL, ONLINE_JUDGE, SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS; plain and march=native. No NDEBUG. CPU 14 and the shared benchmark flock. Five rotated runs of baseline, an identical-code control, and candidates. The sieve is constructed before enumeration timing; mode 0 creates and destroys a result vector, mode 1 appends to a reused pre-reserved vector with prefix 101, and mode 2 counts.

The updated range driver places compiler barriers before each measured operation and after obtaining vector data. The initial indexed / SIMD driver has a count barrier only after count; its count numbers should not be used as evidence of intrinsic count changes. Both drivers are only local probes: main and submission I/O are not modified.

Limits: 31, 127, 16383, 16384, 1e6, 1e7, 1e8, 5e8. The outlined variant also includes 1048575, 1048576, 1048577. Mixed-driver append/count differences do not establish intrinsic changes because those operation sources are identical. No result here is a whole-program judge speed claim.

## Outlined range result (candidate / baseline median)

| configuration | 1048577 enumeration | 1e8 enumeration | 5e8 enumeration | remaining regression |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| GCC plain | 1.054 | 0.985 | 0.987 | threshold +5.4% |
| GCC native | 0.971 | 0.965 | 0.985 | tiny size 31 +4.2% |
| Clang plain | 0.936 | 0.969 | 0.943 | no large measured regression |
| Clang native | 0.891 | 0.965 | 0.950 | unchanged small path +4–10% |

The small-path differences reflect generated code/layout changes in this translation unit even though the API operations are unchanged. The identical-code control is generally within about 2% for those highlighted Clang native cases. Roughly fifty added lines plus further compiler/size switching are not justified by the modest and inconsistent GCC improvement. Keep baseline enumeration.

## Correctness and evidence

Initial from_range and forced feature fallback pass complete list comparisons against an independent byte/boolean sieve through 1e6, GCC / Clang warning builds, and Clang ASan/UBSan. Outlined range and fallback are additionally checked around the new threshold through 1.1e6. The first attempt at expanding that test accidentally left the reference vector at the old size; the test harness was corrected before recording results. Indexed/SIMD prototypes only received size/back checksum checks; no full API correctness claim is made for those rejected implementations.

Files: `results.json` / `summary.json` (first probes), `range_results.json` / `range_summary.json`, `outline_results.json` / `outline_summary.json`, `range_checks.json`, `outline_checks.json`, and the corresponding source drivers and build scripts. All timing jobs ended and the lock was released. No candidate is recommended for integration.
